headline: Bond selloff drives a sharp book value drop and a loss

kpis.label: Net spread and dollar roll income per share
Tangible net book value per share
Economic return on tangible common equity
Tangible net book value at-risk leverage

summary_short: AGNC reported a Q3 2026 net loss of $(1.17) per share and tangible net book value of $7.13, down 16.9% from $8.58; net spread and dollar roll income was $0.37 per share.
summary_long: Agency mortgage bonds were the worst performing sector of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate index in the quarter, and AGNC's economic return on tangible common equity was -12.7%. Tangible net book value fell $1.45 to $7.13 per share against $0.36 of dividends. Net spread and dollar roll income eased to $0.37 from $0.40, including a $0.05 catch-up premium amortization benefit that is excluded. Leverage rose to 7.9x from 7.4x, and the company raised $992 million through at-the-market stock sales. Liquidity was $6.3 billion.
confidence_notes: Net spread and dollar roll income is a non-GAAP measure; GAAP net loss includes large derivative and mark-to-market swings. Shard EPS of 0.37 matches the non-GAAP measure, not GAAP net loss per share of $(1.17).

drivers.explanation: Management says fixed income sentiment turned bearish, rates rose sharply and volatility spiked, pressuring Agency mortgage bonds in the final weeks of September.

drivers.metric: Tangible net book value per share
drivers.explanation: The decline combined a $1.45 drop in book value per share with $0.36 of dividends, producing the negative economic return.

drivers.metric: Net spread and dollar roll income per share
drivers.explanation: Net interest spread narrowed to 1.86% from 2.00% as cost of funds rose to 3.09% from 2.89%.

drivers.metric: Tangible net book value at-risk leverage
drivers.explanation: Leverage rose to 7.9x from 7.4x at quarter end; the company also issued $992 million of common stock through its at-the-market program.
